title: Webb County Sheriff's Office joins End the Streak pedestrian safety press event at City Hall
excerpt: Chief Tim Tubbs and Lieutenant Erik Alba represented the Webb County Sheriff's Office at the End the Streak pedestrian safety press event at the City Hall Council Chambers, urging drivers and pedestrians to stay alert and share the road.
content:
Chief Tim Tubbs and Lieutenant Erik Alba represented the Webb County Sheriff's Office at the Pedestrian Safety End the Streak press event held at the City Hall Council Chambers.

The initiative draws attention to pedestrian safety and the shared responsibility everyone has in preventing roadway tragedies.

The Sheriff's Office encourages motorists and pedestrians to remain alert, follow traffic laws, use designated crosswalks, and always look out for one another.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar said, “Every life matters. Every step toward safer roads makes a difference.”

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, November 12, 2026.
